company.shortDescription: AlgoDriven is an automotive technology company that provides AI-powered vehicle data intelligence and car valuation software.
company.description: AlgoDriven develops digital tools that analyze large datasets from the automotive market to deliver accurate vehicle pricing, appraisal reports, and market insights. Its technology combines artificial intelligence, proprietary transaction data, and VIN-based vehicle information to provide businesses with reliable pricing recommendations and condition assessments for used vehicles.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $2,000,000, or 68.97% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,584,963 to $15,305,562, a 9.66x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
